title: Full Roofline in Cool Blue — Brantford
description: Every peak, eave and gable traced in colour-matched track, shown here in cool blue. The same system runs warm white on an ordinary Tuesday.

title: Warm White Everyday — London
description: What permanent lighting looks like on a night with no occasion at all — clean warm-white curb appeal, no extension cords, nothing to take down.

title: Soffit & Peak Detail — Oxford County
description: Close-up of track following the soffit line and gable peaks on a brick-and-stone build. Note how the housing sits inside the trim channel.

title: Christmas in Deep Blue — Tillsonburg
description: Mid-winter, mid-snowfall, and still running. Cold-rated to −40°C, so the display doesn't quit when the weather turns.

title: Tree Wrapping — Municipal Park
description: Warm-white wrapping on mature park maples for a municipal seasonal display, installed and removed on the town's schedule.

title: Streetscape Hedging — Commercial Frontage
description: Cedar hedging along a commercial frontage lit for the season — high visibility from the street without touching the building envelope.

title: Entrance Approach — Commercial Property
description: Warm-white hedge lighting framing a pedestrian approach, keeping the walkway bright and the frontage seasonal.
